newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up slightly on Lujiazui.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up slightly on Lujiazui.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended up modestly on Thursday on institutional support buying of Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development, but follow-up buying was limited due to poor market sentiment, brokers said.
The index edged up 0.025 points or 0.05 percent to 48.928 points on volume of 7.6 million shares worth $2.8 million. Of 41 B shares, 34 traded, with 11 up, eight flat and 15 down.
Brokers said poor market seniment limited follow-up buying despite institutional support for market barometer Shanghai Lujiazui.
Shanghai Lujiazui was the third biggest winner, rising $0.028 or 3.11 percent to $0.928 on volume of 872,800 shares.
"Some institutions are buying selective stocks to support their own positions, but given the sluggish trading there was little buying interest from other investors," one broker said.
"Technical charts show the market will fall further," a second broker said. "Overseas selling is expected to continue because they has lost confidence in the market after a long bearish performance."
China Textile Machinery was the star on speculative buying, jumping $0.010 or 10.00 percent to $0.110 on volume of 5,000 shares.
Shanghai Steel Tube was the biggest loser on unpromising prospects, falling $0.006 or 4.68 percent to $0.122 on volume of 10,000 shares.
Shanghai A shares reversed early gains on profit-taking selling, but market sentiment was good with trading active, brokers said.
The A index fell 10.809 points or 1.18 percent to 908.137 points, on volume of 558.6 million shares worth 5.4 billion yuan. The SSE 30 fell 44.621 points or 1.81 percent to 2417.842 points.
The speculative stock Shanghai Hero was the worst performer, plunging 2.38 yuan or 11.56 percent to 18.20 yuan on volume of 773,500 shares.
